_readme: Feature verification list. Set a platform to true only after actually walking through the steps; do not edit or remove steps. browser = in a browser (including npm run test:e2e); windows / mac = the desktop app on real hardware. e2e names the automated test file, if any.

features.description: Import an .xlsx/.csv snippet sheet; invalid and duplicate rows are reported
steps: Import docs/samples/clipbox-test-snippets.csv
34 imported, 2 invalid rows, 1 duplicate reported

features.description: Copy puts the content on the clipboard and never clears it afterwards
steps: Open a snippet
Click 复制
Paste into another app

features.description: Switching entries: the new card expands, the old card folds away gradually, no white border flash
steps: Open entry 2
Click entry 5
The old card folds away in about 0.2 s

features.description: Company 话术 library: sync from an address or file adds new entries and updates untouched ones; edited entries keep the employee's text with a 公司版有更新 mark and a compare; dropped entries are only marked 公司已停用; nothing is deleted or overwritten
steps: Settings → 共享话术 → 选公司文件… docs/samples/shared-library-v1.json
Edit one company 话术, then sync v2
Open the marked 话术: choose 保留我的 or 用公司版

features.description: 设置首页 账号与同步 takes a 企业同步码: it picks that group's file on copyboxx.com/sync/<code>/snippets.json, a wrong code says 找不到这个同步码, and the app syncs again by itself on start and every 30 minutes (D-052)
steps: Settings home → 账号与同步: type a 企业同步码, 立即同步
Leave the app open 30 minutes after the company publishes: a 共享话术已同步 toast appears

features.description: 登录同步 with an address at a company domain bound on the server gets that company's 话术 library without a 同步码 (GET /api/library, D-072); a typed 同步码 wins; free-mail domains never match; 设置 shows 「公司话术：按邮箱自动获取（domain）」
steps: Preview: 设置 → 登录同步 with someone@example.com, code 123456 → 3 company 话术 arrive and the line shows
Sign in with a gmail address → nothing arrives, no line
Type a 同步码 → the domain library is no longer applied

features.description: 第一次打开、话术为空且没填企业同步码时，空白页第一个按钮是「输入企业同步码」，点了打开设置首页并把光标放进同步码栏；新手引导的话术页提到同步码 (D-052)
steps: Fresh start: empty 话术 list shows 输入企业同步码 first
Click it: Settings opens with the cursor in 企业同步码
Fill a code and close: the button is gone

features.description: 侧栏 Tips 卡片（原「每日小贴士」，可点上一条 / 下一条翻看）先轮播公司的 34 条业务小贴士 (docs/company-tips.md → app/company-tips.ts)，再轮播使用技巧；打开后正确写法是高亮块，错误写法划掉变灰，来源在最后；之前在看使用技巧的人当天就换到第一条公司小贴士
steps: Open the app: the card reads Tips and shows 拿不准就叫 lovely, with the start of the text ending in …
Click 上一条 / 下一条: other tips show, wrapping at both ends; a reload shows today's tip again
Open the card: 上一条 / 下一条 in the dialog show other tips; after 知道了 the card shows the last one read
Click it: the right way shows as a highlight block, the wrong way struck through, then 来源
Next day: the next company tip

features.description: Variables show as highlighted blocks without brackets; click a block and type right there, Enter jumps to the next empty block and copies when all are filled; copying with a block empty puts the cursor in it; each block remembers its last three values (this session only) and offers them when focused: clicking one fills it and copies at once if no other block is empty; values carried over from an earlier copy need one look first (the first copy shows them and asks to copy again); right-click a block (or a listed value) to pin it so new values never push it out, a ? at the block's right edge explains; Name starts as Friend and offers beautiful / Friend / Lovely above the block; right-click a listed value for 固定 / 解锁 / 删除, hold and move it to reorder; when adding a 话术 by hand, select words and click 设为高亮 to make a block
steps: Open a snippet with variables
Click a highlighted block and type
Press Enter in the last block (or click 复制)
Click a block again: the last three values are listed; click one

features.description: Inline editing; 小提示 field up to 40 characters; save and copy
steps: Click 编辑
Change content and 小提示
Save

features.description: AI polish / tidy use the endpoint from Settings and can be undone
steps: Settings → AI: pick a preset, enter a key
保存并测试 reports success
Edit a snippet, click AI 润色, then 撤销

features.description: The API key is stored with OS encryption (Windows DPAPI / macOS Keychain) and only sent to the saved server
steps: Save a key in the desktop app
ai-key.json in the data folder shows no plain-text key

features.description: Create/rename/recolour/delete/drag-sort folders in Settings and the sidebar; standard snippet folders are fixed
steps: Settings → 目录: create three folders
Drag to reorder
Sidebar order matches

features.description: Folder ⋯ menu: 置顶 puts a 话术 or 图片 folder at the top (pin order, small pin mark, kept after restart); 取消置顶 puts it back in its old place
steps: Open ⋯ on the third folder and choose 置顶: it moves to the top with a pin
Pin another folder: it goes below the first pinned one
Restart: the order stays
Open ⋯ on a pinned folder: it says 取消置顶; choose it and the folder goes back

features.description: No keyboard shortcut hints and no modifier shortcuts anywhere
steps: No Ctrl/⌘ labels visible
Ctrl+E does nothing

features.description: (Removed by D-017: Windows has 图片 instead of 备注) Second section is 备注: plain text, no masking/reference/segments
steps: Switch to 备注
Add an entry
Open it: content is shown directly

features.description: Second section is 秘密 with masking, hold-to-reveal and copy reference
steps: Switch to 秘密
Add an entry
Hold to reveal, copy reference

features.description: Full window min 680×620; mini window 360×440 always on top, position remembered
steps: Shrink the window to its minimum
Switch to mini
Quit and reopen

features.description: Mini window 话术 rows: a click opens the row in place with the whole text and only 修改 (one open at a time); hovering shows a floating 复制 button that copies without opening and turns into ✓ 已复制 with a short pop; folder tabs show two-character names with the full name as tooltip
steps: Switch to mini
Click a 话术 row: the whole text and 修改 show; click another row: the first closes
Hover a row and click 复制; paste elsewhere
Click 修改 and save a change
Folder tabs read 询盘 产品 报价 …; hover one to see the full name

features.description: Tray icon opens the mini window; close button goes to tray or quits per Settings
steps: Click the tray icon
After copying it hides per Settings
Click the window's close button

features.description: Windows only: closing can shrink the window to the taskbar (Settings), and clicking the taskbar icon brings it back; reopening from the tray, Start menu or a second launch restores a minimised window
steps: Settings → 点击窗口关闭按钮时 → 缩到任务栏
Click the window's close button
The window shrinks to the taskbar; click its icon to reopen

features.description: Silent launch at login (--hidden on Windows)
steps: Enable launch at login in Settings
Restart the computer
Only the tray icon appears, no window

features.description: Packaging: Windows NSIS installer; macOS arm64 .app only
steps: On Windows run npm run desktop:pack:win and install
On a Mac run npm run desktop:pack and open

features.description: Windows: 有新版本 banner with 立即更新 downloads the installer with a progress bar, checks size and SHA-256, saves, installs over the old version and reopens the new one; errors offer 重试 and 去网站下载; 稍后 hides that version (D-047)
steps: Install an older build that has this code; deploy a newer installer and latest.json to copyboxx.com
Open the app: the banner says 有新版本; click 立即更新
The bar and 已下载 x / y MB move, then 正在安装，马上自动重新打开
A small installer window runs and closes by itself; the new version opens with all data and launch at login kept
Pull the network cable during a download: 更新没成功 with 重试 and 去网站下载

features.description: Mac: 有新版本 banner from latest-mac.json; 下载 opens the zipped app in the browser and the banner says how to replace the old app; 知道了 hides it until the next launch (D-073)
steps: Build a Mac app with this code; upload a newer zip and latest-mac.json to the update folder
Open the app: the banner says 有新版本; click 下载
The browser downloads the zip; the banner says 正在浏览器里下载 with the drag-into-应用程序 hint
Replace the old app with the new one; it opens with all content kept
Quit and reopen the old version before replacing: the banner comes back

features.description: The product is called Copyboxx (复制盒): the first settings page opens with both names, 关于 shows Copyboxx v…, window title and tray say Copyboxx (D-046)
steps: Open 设置: Copyboxx and 复制盒 at the top of 外观
关于 shows Copyboxx v…
Desktop: window title and tray tooltip say Copyboxx

features.description: Windows installer Copyboxx-Windows-setup.exe: Chinese only, the app icon instead of NSIS's, the 复制盒 picture instead of the stock computer picture on the first and last page, 「Copyboxx 复制盒」 at the bottom; new icon in the taskbar, Start menu and tray (D-046)
steps: Download Copyboxx-Windows-setup.exe from a tauri-test-N release and run it
Every page is in Chinese; the first and last page show the 复制盒 picture
After installing: the Start menu, taskbar and tray show the box-with-cards icon

features.description: Launch at login moves from an older install (Clipbox / Clipboxx) to Copyboxx; the old entry is removed (D-046)
steps: Have Clipboxx installed with 开机启动 on
Quit Clipboxx, install and open Copyboxx
设置 shows 开机启动 on; after a restart Copyboxx starts in the tray, Clipboxx does not

features.description: Encrypted export/import of the snippet backup (excludes 备注/秘密)
steps: Settings → 导出话术备份
Clear, then import
Snippets are back

features.description: Encrypted export of the 秘密 section (macOS; 备注 on Windows was removed by D-017) to its own local file (no snippets); restored with 导入备份
steps: Settings → 导出备注备份 (导出秘密备份 on Mac)
Move the note to the trash
导入备份 → 覆盖: the note is back, snippets untouched

features.description: Daily automatic backup keeps each picture once (backups/images/), leaves thumbnails and the pre-migration 账号 copy out, restores with thumbnails made again, and says in 设置 when a backup failed (D-043)
steps: Add two pictures, wait for today's backup: backups/images/ holds two .bin files
Next day: no new .bin file unless a picture was added
设置 → 数据 → 从自动备份恢复 → pick a day → 确认替换: the pictures and their thumbnails are back
Make the backups folder read-only: 设置 shows 「最近一次自动备份没有成功」 until a later backup succeeds

features.description: 图片 section: add (file, drop, paste), copy the picture as PNG, rename, search, delete (goes to the 回收站 first, restore or delete for good there); stored encrypted on the device
steps: Switch to 图片 (Windows: 话术 | 图片; Mac: 话术 | 秘密 | 图片)
新增图片 → pick a PNG and a JPG
Click 复制 and paste into a chat app: the picture appears
改名, search by title, 删除 → it moves to 回收站 (撤销 for 6 seconds); in 回收站 try 恢复 and 永久删除 → confirm
Quit and reopen: the images are still there

features.description: 图片 16宫格: 4 square tiles per row, whole picture shown (no crop) with a 6% margin on frosted glass, text-labelled copy button revealed on hover or keyboard focus in main and mini windows, tile click opens a full-width detail card, 宫格 | 列表 switch remembered per device, mini window grid
steps: Switch to 图片 with 10+ pictures
Four tiles per row, each picture fully visible; click the copy button on a tile and paste elsewhere
Click a tile: its card opens below the row; click again to close
Switch to 列表 and back; reload keeps the choice
Mini window: tiles in 4 columns, clicking one copies it

features.description: 图片 folders: create / rename / recolour / delete, move images between folders, filter, 未分类; deleting a folder keeps its images
steps: Switch to 图片
Click + next to 目录 and create 收款码
Open an image → 目录 → move it into 收款码
The folder count goes up; select the folder to see only its images
Delete the folder: the image is back in 未分类

features.description: Move to trash with undo; restore, delete permanently, auto-purge
steps: Delete an entry
Undo within 6 s
Restore from 回收站

features.description: System / light / dark theme
steps: Switch all three themes in Settings

features.description: First-run guide: four pages (话术, 图片, 账号, 迷你窗口和备份) shown once when the full window first opens, never in the mini window; 跳过 / × / Esc / 开始使用 close it for good; 设置 → 关于 → 再看一遍 opens it again
steps: Start with fresh data: the guide opens on 1 / 4
下一步, 上一步 and the dots change pages
跳过, then reload: it does not come back
设置 → 关于 → 使用说明 → 再看一遍: it opens on page 1

features.description: Own folders (话术, 图片; 账号 has no 目录 since D-058) can get a short name for the mini window's folder tabs from a quiet ⋯ in 设置 → 目录; standard 话术 folders keep their fixed ones; longer than two characters is refused with 最多两个字
steps: 设置 → 目录 → 话术目录: create 客户跟单; standard folders have no ⋯
Click ⋯ on 客户跟单: 迷你窗口显示为, placeholder 客户
Type 跟单员 and 保存: 最多两个字, nothing saved
Type 跟单 and 保存; mini window tab reads 跟单, tooltip 客户跟单; reload keeps it
⋯ → 恢复默认: the tab reads 客户 again
Same for an image folder in 图片目录

features.description: 账号 page is frosted (blurred, unreachable) until the 「向右滑动解锁」 knob is slid to the end; a short slide springs back; frosted again after leaving 账号 or hiding the window; the knob also opens with →/End/Enter/Space when focused; with 账号页密码 set only the password screen shows; 设置 → 安全 「打开账号页先滑动解锁」 turns it off (default on); the mini window is unchanged
steps: Open 账号: the content is blurred and the slider shows
Drag the knob halfway and let go: it springs back
Drag it to the end: the blur fades and the page can be used
Switch to 话术 and back: frosted again
设置 → 安全: set 打开账号页先滑动解锁 to 关, open 账号: no slider

features.description: 设置 has a 安全 group (账号页密码, 打开账号页先滑动解锁, 账号页自动上锁, 始终允许的程序); after the 账号 page is opened it locks again after 10 / 20 (default) / 30 秒 without activity, back to the password screen or the slide frost; 不上锁 asks first (D-070)
steps: 设置 → 安全: 账号页自动上锁 shows 20 秒 selected
Open 账号, slide it open, leave the mouse still for 20 seconds: frosted again
Pick 不上锁: a confirm card asks; 取消 keeps 20 秒; 确认不上锁 keeps the page open
Set 账号页密码 and 10 秒, open 账号 with the password, wait 10 seconds: the password screen is back

features.description: 设置窗口用品牌配色和字体（和弹窗一样）：浅色米白底、深色近黑底，选中的分类有橙色小竖线，行之间只有一条细线；字体随软件自带（英文 Poppins / Lora，Windows 中文 MiSans，Mac 苹方），关于里注明；设置项的位置和作用不变
steps: Open 设置 in light and dark: brand surface and ink, orange bar on the selected tab
Click through every tab: all settings still in the same place

features.description: 设置首页（概览）顶部在 Copyboxx 字标右边显示版本号和更新日期（年月日，按台北日历，不写时区）；下面一张「账号与同步」卡片：账号（打开账号页 / 安全设置）和同步（公司话术库的最后同步时间，去同步跳到 数据 → 共享话术）
steps: Open 设置: top right of the first page reads vX.XX · YYYY年M月D日更新
账号与同步 → 打开账号页: Settings closes on the 账号 page
账号与同步 → 同步 shows 最后同步 … or 还没有同步过; 去同步 opens 数据 at 共享话术

features.description: Hidden 账号 values (登录密码, API 密钥, 恢复码, Mac 秘密) have two buttons: 「按住显示」 shows only while pressed; 「显示」 keeps it shown until 「隐藏」 or the entry is folded
steps: 账号 → 登录 → open an entry
Hold 按住显示: password shows, release hides
Click 显示: stays shown, button reads 隐藏
Fold and reopen the entry: hidden again

features.description: MCP creates custom snippet folders, assigns snippets to existing custom folders and renames custom folders while preserving contents, colors, short names and pins; standard folders remain protected
steps: Create a custom folder through MCP and add or move a snippet into it
Pin and select it, rename through MCP, verify selection and contents follow
Reload: the new folder, contents and pin remain
Try renaming a standard folder or using a duplicate name: no write

features.description: MCP batch snippet reads/updates and local image import, metadata, previews and folder organization; existing UI and encrypted stores reused
steps: Read numbered snippets, batch-update with current timestamps, reload and verify; stale batch changes nothing
Import a generated local image, retry without duplication, rename and move it, reload and verify
Read a bounded image preview and list/rename its folder
Rename a selected, pinned image folder through MCP using lowercase or padded input: count, selection, pin and image stay correct before and after reload

features.description: 本机接口（D-060）：Codex、Claude Code 等 AI 工具用「Copyboxx --mcp」连接正在运行的 Copyboxx，查看、新增、修改、移动、删除（进回收站）话术；读秘密前 Copyboxx 先弹窗问；设置 → AI →「连接 Codex 等工具」显示可复制的连接命令
steps: 设置 → AI → 连接 Codex 等工具: the Codex command shows this computer's program path; 复制 copies it
Run that command in a terminal once, open Codex and ask it to list Copyboxx snippets: it lists them while Copyboxx is open
Ask Codex to add a snippet: Copyboxx shows 外部任务已新增 CB-…
Quit Copyboxx and ask again: Codex says Copyboxx is not open
Mac: ask Codex to read a 秘密 by its reference: Copyboxx asks 允许读取秘密吗？; 拒绝 makes the call fail

features.description: 账号 is sorted by 分类 only on both platforms: no 目录 list, no 未分类, no 新建目录, no 目录 field for old entries, no 「移动到」, no 账号目录 in 设置 → 目录 (D-058); old entries keep their stored folder
steps: Mac: open 账号: the sidebar has 全部/收藏/最近 and 分类, no 目录
其他 → 新增: the editor has no 目录 field
设置 → 目录: only 话术目录 and 图片目录

features.description: 账号 has a 笔记 category (both platforms): free notes in Markdown with 编辑/预览, shown safely (no HTML, links http(s) only), searchable by content, 复制全文
steps: 账号 → 笔记 → 新增
Write a heading, a list and a link, check 预览, save
The note shows formatted; the link opens the web page
Search a word from the note in 全部: it is found

features.description: 「转为登录…」 on a note previews which line fills 名称/网址/用户名/密码/备注 (changeable per field), saves a login that keeps the note's text (看原文), and 「还原为笔记」 brings the note back unchanged
steps: Open a note with 网址/账号/密码 lines → 转为登录…
Check or change the mapping, 保存为登录
The login opens with 由笔记「…」转来 and 看原文
还原为笔记 → 确认还原: the note is back as it was, the login is gone

features.description: Mac only: 「转为 API…」 on a note previews 名称/服务/接口地址 and each hidden field (name, value, source line; rows can be added or removed) plus 备注, saves an API entry with the fields hidden, keeps the note (看原文) and 「还原为笔记」; Windows shows no 转为 API
steps: Mac: open a note with 服务/地址/Client ID/Client Secret lines → 转为 API…
Check the fields, 保存为 API
The API entry shows 2 hidden fields and 由笔记「…」转来
还原为笔记 → 确认还原: the note is back

features.description: Mac/Linux command line: the 「允许读取秘密吗？」 question shows 来自：<program> and a third button 「始终允许」; that program then reads or checks one 秘密 without asking (toast 已自动允许「…」读取秘密); another program, or an export of all 秘密, is still asked; 设置 → 数据 → 始终允许的程序 lists the programs with 取消; the list is not in backups (D-059)
steps: Mac: in Terminal run clipbox secret-get <reference>: the question shows 来自：Terminal (or the program that ran it)
Click 始终允许: the value is printed; run it again: no question, a toast says 已自动允许
Run clipbox secret-export …: still asked, no 始终允许
设置 → 数据 → 始终允许的程序: the program is listed; 取消 removes it and the next read asks again
From Codex: ask it to run clipbox secret-get; the question shows 来自：codex

features.description: An API 密钥 entry holds several named hidden fields (Key, Secret, Client ID…, up to 10) and a plain 备注; old entries show their key as 「密钥」 (Mac; D-061)
steps: 账号 → API 密钥 → 新增
Fill 密钥, click 再加一项 twice (Secret, Client ID), fill 备注, 保存
Row shows 尾号 xxxx · 3 项; each field hidden with its own 按住显示 / 显示 and copy
修改: rename / remove a field; a duplicate name is refused

features.description: 账号 rows start with the website's logo: about 120 big sites (Gmail, Instagram, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Amazon, 阿里巴巴, 小红书 …) are bundled and matched by address, subdomains included, or by name; other sites keep the coloured initial or their own fetched icon (D-031); the card title shows the logo only when 收起
steps: 账号 → 新增 登录 with address mail.google.com, another with www.instagram.com
Each row shows the Gmail / Instagram logo
A login for an unknown site shows its coloured initial

features.description: 设置 → 概览 → 账号与同步 → 登录同步: sign in with an email code (no password), then 话术 and 账号 sync between the person's computers on start, a few seconds after a change and every 10 minutes; Windows syncs 账号 passwords, a Mac keeps passwords / API secrets / recovery codes on the Mac; a locked 账号 page syncs only 话术; 退出登录 keeps local data; 注销账号 asks first and deletes the cloud copy. Real installs reach https://copyboxx.com/api through the app; the preview uses a pretend server with code 123456 (D-064)
steps: Preview (Windows): 设置 → 登录… → email → 发送验证码 → 123456 → 登录
The card shows 已登录, the email and 最后同步
Add a 话术, wait about 10 seconds: 最后同步 moves to now and 上次同步 says what went up
退出登录: the 话术 stay; 注销… → 注销: the cloud copy is gone

features.description: 登录同步: one account is signed in on at most 3 computers; a 4th sign-in signs out the oldest and says which (「已超过 3 台，最早登录的「Windows 电脑」已自动退出登录」), and the signed-out computer says why the next time it syncs (D-069)
steps: Preview (Windows): sign in with the same email in 4 browser profiles or after seeding 3 sessions
The 4th shows the notice under 已登录
On the oldest, 立即同步 shows 「这个账号在别的电脑上登录了…」 and 登录… again

features.description: 更新通知 (D-071): after an app update (lines in app/release-notes.ts) or a 同步码 push with a notice, a small brand-style card lists what is new, once; a new install or the first sync of a library shows nothing; 知道了 / Esc closes it
steps: Preview: 看更新通知 → 软件更新 shows 「Copyboxx 已更新」 with sample lines; 知道了 closes it
设置 → 数据 → 选公司文件…: first shared-library-v1.json, then a v2 file with a notice → the card 「公司话术有更新」 shows once
Sync the same file again → no card
